verdict.rationale: Exa has a dedicated rate-limits docs page stating that endpoints have default rate limits, and it lets you set a lower per-key limit. Self-serve billing (add credits, auto recharge) and a free tier with no payment method are documented. missing for 10: the actual rate-limit numbers in the evidence, any documented concurrency caps, an explicit self-serve path to raise rate limits (billing credits are not the same as raising limits), and independent corroboration.
